svg.text: Water-district tanker · Dr. Maren Vale — contestant vehicle dossier
Tank weeps black-green slurry — the river’s poison
Choked in kudzu and a pale, wrong growth
Theo’s hard hat on the mirror — too small
Once flushed the very mains she sabotaged
A municipal water tanker truck choked in creeping
kudzu and pale sickly growth, rusted white-and-
green paint, the tank weeping black-green toxic
slurry from every seam, eerie and overgrown,
Realistic · Symmetry On · Quad · ~55k tris · PBR 4K
